apps.message:
feat: the entry format as a schema (Zod, published as JSON Schema)

## Intent

The entry format of the app overview needs one source that defines it, checks every entry and is published for editors and agents. Nothing needs to stay compatible with the map, so the schemas move out of it.

## Key changes

- schemas/entry.js is the only source of the entry format; the build checks every entry against it and replaces the hand-written checks, with readable messages.
- npm run schema writes schemas/entry.v1.schema.json; the check fails when it is out of date.
- The schema is published at /apps/schemas/; the Mathe-Karte entry and llms.txt point to it.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The redirect pull request of lernapps/map no longer publishes schemas; the schema of the competency nodes stays unpublished in the parked map.
